thesis: The speakers argue that the ultimate end state of AI agents is autonomous systems running in the background to execute real work with minimal human intervention, rather than simple chat interfaces. They further contend that achieving this requires a shift from monolithic systems to orchestrated networks of specialized agents that can run long tasks while maintaining self-reflection and avoiding anthropomorphization.
